name: customer-pack
title: Internal customer distribution pack
for_each: select id,name from customers order by name

sections.title: Current obligations
sections.note: Review the source PDF before delivery. This pack is not a safety data sheet.
sections.sql: select q.sku,q.product,q.country,q.language,q.version,q.issue from distribution_queue q join subscriptions s on s.id=q.id where s.customer_id=$1 order by q.sku

sections.title: Delivery evidence
sections.sql: select p.sku,sh.version,d.delivered_on,d.evidence from deliveries d join subscriptions s on s.id=d.subscription_id join products p on p.id=s.product_id join sheets sh on sh.id=d.sheet_id where s.customer_id=$1 order by d.delivered_on

name: supplier-review
title: Internal supplier follow-up sheet
for_each: select id,name from products order by sku

sections.title: Document versions
sections.sql: select country,language,version,issued_on,status,review_ref from sheets where product_id=$1 order by issued_on desc

sections.title: Affected customers
sections.sql: select customer,country,language,issue from distribution_queue where sku=(select sku from products where id=$1) order by customer
